text.en: Hattori and Chiri (1960) conducted a basic-vocabulary survey covering 200 items elicited from speakers representing nineteen distinct localities across Hokkaido and Sakhalin ⟦claim:sources/dialect-sample-and-corpus-method--hattori-chiri-nineteen-locality-lexicostatistical-survey⟧.
text.ja: 服部四郎・知里真志保（1960）は、北海道および樺太の計19地点の話者から基礎語彙200項目を収集する調査を行った⟦claim:sources/dialect-sample-and-corpus-method--hattori-chiri-nineteen-locality-lexicostatistical-survey⟧。

text.en: Refsing (1986) asserts that clear and reliable isoglosses cannot be established between Ainu dialects, because investigations have necessarily relied on only one or two speakers per locality ⟦claim:sources/dialect-sample-and-corpus-method--isogloss-unreliability-due-to-limited-speakers⟧.
text.ja: Refsing（1986）は、アイヌ語の方言調査は必然的に各地点1〜2名の話者に依存してきたため、方言間に明確で信頼できる等語線を引くことは不可能であると主張する⟦claim:sources/dialect-sample-and-corpus-method--isogloss-unreliability-due-to-limited-speakers⟧。
